## 2-Week Spanish Travel Starter Plan

A simple 14-day plan for a true beginner, built for **45 minutes per day** and focused on **basic travel conversations**. It uses free resources only and balances vocabulary, listening, speaking, and review every day.

## Day-by-Day Spanish Practice Plan

| Day | Focus | 45-Minute Plan | Goal |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Greetings and basics | Vocabulary: hello, goodbye, please, thank you; Listening: short beginner greetings video; Speaking: say 10 greetings aloud; Review: write 5 new words | Introduce yourself politely |
| 2 | Numbers and spelling | Vocabulary: 0–20, letters; Listening: numbers pronunciation; Speaking: count items and spell your name; Review: quick flashcard recall | Understand simple numbers |
| 3 | Travel essentials | Vocabulary: airport, hotel, ticket, passport, suitcase; Listening: travel phrases audio; Speaking: “I need a ticket” practice; Review: match words to meaning | Use core travel words |
| 4 | Ordering food and drinks | Vocabulary: water, coffee, menu, bill, hungry; Listening: café dialogue; Speaking: order a drink and meal; Review: repeat phrases from memory | Order simply in a café |
| 5 | Directions and places | Vocabulary: left, right, straight, near, far; Listening: asking directions clip; Speaking: ask where the bathroom is; Review: draw a mini route and label it | Ask for directions |
| 6 | Present tense survival verbs | Vocabulary: be, have, want, need, go; Listening: verb examples in context; Speaking: make 8 short sentences; Review: quiz yourself on meanings | Build basic sentences |
| 7 | Weekly review day | Vocabulary: review Days 1–6; Listening: replay your hardest audio; Speaking: 2-minute self-introduction; Review: test yourself with flashcards | Consolidate Week 1 |

| Day | Focus | 45-Minute Plan | Goal |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | Hotel check-in | Vocabulary: reservation, room, key, breakfast, floor; Listening: hotel front desk dialogue; Speaking: check in and ask for Wi‑Fi; Review: write 5 useful hotel phrases | Handle check-in basics |
| 9 | Transportation | Vocabulary: bus, train, taxi, station, stop; Listening: transport announcements; Speaking: ask about a ticket and schedule; Review: practice times and numbers | Use public transport |
| 10 | Shopping and prices | Vocabulary: cheap, expensive, size, price, cash; Listening: store dialogue; Speaking: ask “How much?” and answer; Review: practice numbers with prices | Buy simple items |
| 11 | Emergencies and health | Vocabulary: help, doctor, pharmacy, pain, lost; Listening: emergency phrases; Speaking: ask for help clearly; Review: memorize 5 emergency sentences | Get help if needed |
| 12 | Past and future basics | Vocabulary: yesterday, today, tomorrow, later, now; Listening: simple time expressions; Speaking: say what you did and will do; Review: make 5 time-based sentences | Talk about time |
| 13 | Travel conversation practice | Vocabulary: review all travel words; Listening: short mixed dialogue; Speaking: role-play airport, hotel, café; Review: note weak words and repeat them | Combine skills in context |
| 14 | Final review and test | Vocabulary: full review; Listening: one beginner travel conversation; Speaking: 3-minute mock trip conversation; Review: check progress list and set next steps | Confirm travel readiness |

## Free Learning Routine for Each Day

- **Vocabulary (10 min):** Learn 5–8 new words or phrases.
- **Listening (10 min):** Use free YouTube beginner lessons, podcasts, or language-site audio.
- **Speaking (15 min):** Read aloud, shadow phrases, or role-play travel situations.
- **Review (10 min):** Revisit yesterday’s words and test recall without looking.

## Progress Checklist

Use this at the end of Day 7 and Day 14:

- I can greet someone and say thank you politely.
- I can understand numbers, prices, and basic times.
- I can ask for directions and understand simple answers.
- I can order food or drinks in a café.
- I can check in at a hotel using short sentences.
- I can ask for help in an emergency.
- I can say what I need, where I’m going, and what I want.
- I can hold a 1–2 minute basic travel conversation slowly.

## Quick Actions

- BBC Languages Spanish: https://www.bbc.co.uk/languages/spanish/

- Quizlet Spanish sets: https://quizlet.com/subject/spanish-beginner/
